intro: The department offers a Bachelor's programme, a Master of Technology and a Doctoral (Ph.D.) programme to build technical and research excellence in specialised avenues of Electrical Engineering.

programs.text: IIT Ropar offers a 4-year B.Tech. programme in Electrical Engineering. Admission is through the IIT Joint Entrance Examination (JEE).
